title: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm

entities.name: Vicious Swarm
entities.description: The Phyrexian faction associated with green mana, ruling the Tangle and rejecting any single cult of leadership.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A native Phyrexian beast who rules the Tangle but cloisters himself in the ruins of Tel-Jilad, advised by Glissa.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A formerly Viridian elf compleated by Phyrexia, now the de facto ruler of the Tangle, who believes in accelerated natural selection and predatory instinct.

entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: A dense forest on Mirrodin of copper and verdigris trees, overtaken by lamina and now ruled by Phyrexia's green faction.

entities.name: Tel-Jilad
entities.description: The ruined focal point of Viridian elf civilization in the Tangle, home of the Tree of Tales.

entities.name: Cambree Garden
entities.description: A garden atop a massive tree near Tel-Jilad that serves as home base for Glissa and her minions.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane now invaded by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invading power that confined itself to Mirrodin's core during the Deadlock and then emerged to convert or kill Mirrans.

entities.name: The Deadlock
entities.description: The years when Phyrexia was confined to Mirrodin's inner core and its hierarchy debated when to attack the surface.

entities.name: Praetors
entities.description: The Phyrexian leaders who built forces for a full-scale assault on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A praetor whom Glissa publicly despises as a decaying sack of flesh idle on a throne.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem who created Mirrodin; Glissa has forgotten this and denies that he is the Father of Machines.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian figure whose memory the green faction does not revere, believing his defeat shows he was not the true Father of Machines.

entities.name: Crotus beasts
entities.description: Fungus-flesh creatures grown by Glissa and Vorinclex that became her enforcers, mostly mindless predators.

entities.name: Sylvok
entities.description: The humans of the Tangle, hit hardest by Phyrexia's emergence and largely killed or compleated.

entities.name: Benzir
entities.description: A young man who was archdruid of the Sylvok and is now the puppet leader of the compleated Sylvok, believing animals hold Phyrexia's collective consciousness.

entities.name: Viridian elves
entities.description: The elves of the Tangle, many of whom hid from the Phyrexian onslaught under Ezuri and formed a resistance.

entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: A young Viridian elf who unified the elves after the Fifth Dawn and leads their resistance against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Sylvok born without metal anatomy and immune to the Phyrexian contagion, raised by Thrun.

entities.name: Thrun
entities.description: The last troll on Mirrodin, a hermit in a tainted part of the Tangle who adopted Melira.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A figure whose treachery Thrun has tattooed on his skin; he brought trolls to Mirrodin in soul traps.

entities.name: The Fifth Dawn
entities.description: The earlier upheaval on Mirrodin after which the elves were in terror and confusion.

events.summary: During the Deadlock, Glissa argues that Phyrexia should strike the surface immediately instead of waiting to build a full-scale assault.
events.quote: Glissa was opposed to waiting until Phyrexia had the forces to wage a full-scale assault.

events.summary: Glissa builds a powerful faction by exploiting discontent, surviving assassination attempts with Vorinclex's help.
events.quote: surviving several assassination attempts with the help of Vorinclex—she constructed a powerful faction through cunning and strength.

events.summary: Glissa and Vorinclex pioneer accelerated growth and she creates crotus blooms in her gardens.
events.quote: She and Vorinclex pioneered a method of escalated growth using an amalgamation of tendon, fat, and brain matter.

events.summary: Glissa warps crotus blooms into crotus beasts as her enforcers, and Phyrexian leadership, unaware of her plans, puts Vorinclex over the forest and assigns Glissa the compleation of local Mirrans.
events.quote: Over time, she warped the crotus blooms into crotus beasts, which become her enforcers.

events.summary: Before the main attack, Glissa sends enforcer-beasts to kill in the Tangle and sets up nodes of control, so the forest is firmly hers when Phyrexians emerge.
events.quote: Even before Phyrexia's attack on the surface began, Glissa sent her enforcer-beasts on killing missions into the Tangle.

events.summary: Phyrexia emerges and the Sylvok are hit hardest; over half die in the first wave after Glissa's arrival.
events.quote: Over half were killed in the first wave following Glissa's arrival in the Tangle.

events.summary: Ezuri leads many Viridian elves into hiding and builds a small resistance in the treetops.
events.quote: Under Ezuri's leadership, however, many of the Viridian elves were able to hide and escape the Phyrexian onslaught.

events.summary: After the Fifth Dawn, the elves retreat into the trees in fear and begin to turn on each other.
events.quote: As a result, the elves retreated inward, taking refuge in natural niches inside the massive trees of the Tangle.

events.summary: Ezuri emerges as a leader, rallying the Viridians and giving them new purpose.
events.quote: A young elf named Ezuri began to unify the Viridians and direct them toward productive tasks.

events.summary: Ezuri organizes the elves into a resistance and contacts other survivors across Mirrodin.
events.quote: Eventually, he organized them into a resistance movement and contacted other survivors across Mirrodin.

events.summary: Melira is abandoned in the Tangle as an infant for her fully organic body and saved by the last troll.
events.quote: But she was saved by an unlikely hero: the last troll living on Mirrodin.

events.summary: Thrun finds Melira, adopts her and teaches her Mirrodin's past and survival skills.
events.quote: Thrun adopted her, instilling in the girl the knowledge of Mirrodin's distant past

events.summary: Thrun realizes that Melira is immune to the Spore and to phyresis, and may be the key to saving Mirrodin.
events.quote: Melira just might be the key to saving all of Mirrodin.

relations.note: He rules the Tangle but hides in Tel-Jilad.
relations.quote: A native Phyrexian beast known as Vorinclex rules the Tangle

relations.note: She is his closest advisor, though now the de facto ruler.
relations.quote: His closest advisor is Glissa, formerly a Viridian elf, who was compleated during the years that Phyrexia lurked in the core.

relations.note: De facto leader of the Tangle.
relations.quote: Although Glissa is the de facto leader of the Tangle, she refuses to identify herself as such.
she is vocal about her hatred of Geth and his "decrepit, slathering idiots."

relations.note: She denies he is the Father of Machines and scorns him.
relations.quote: Now she denies that he is the Father of Machines, and views the silver golem with scorn and ridicule.

relations.note: Karn is the creator of Glissa's world.
relations.quote: including the knowledge that Karn is the creator of her world

relations.note: She made the crotus blooms and beasts.
relations.quote: She named these flowering flesh creations "crotus blooms."

relations.note: Puppet leader of the compleated Sylvok.
relations.quote: Benzir, the puppet leader of the compleated Sylvok
Under Ezuri's leadership, however, many of the Viridian elves were able to hide and escape the Phyrexian onslaught.
Thrun adopted her, instilling in the girl the knowledge of Mirrodin's distant past

relations.note: The faction does not revere his memory.
relations.quote: The green-aligned faction doesn't revere Yawgmoth's memory.
